notes.title: [Patch 1.1] Finish Him!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34689264/7eb60998f78d186fd4a7d4577b8c2f9106ed9eb3.gif

You can now complete the entire game!

There was a bug which prevented users from completing the game and being able to post their high score on the leaderboard. This is now resolved.

Go bowl, or golf, or whatever you want to call it and achieve greatness and let your friends know that King Tooth is proud of your service.
